$comment: Root Directory on the Vercel project is `apps/docs`, so this is the file Vercel reads. `git.deploymentEnabled: false` is the load-bearing line: it turns OFF Vercel's Git integration, so no push to any branch — main included — ever creates a deployment on its own. Every deploy comes through .github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml, which is why there is exactly one URL that is the source of truth. See ofri-peretz/eslint CLAUDE.md, 'Deploy: main branch only'. The install runs at the monorepo root because this app is an npm workspace; the build goes through turbo so the docs share the same task cache as CI.
